unstattable cases for both probes — this file already carries the unit and real-CLI resolution suites

summary: Probe the ancestor `.flume` walk and the `--job` state-root guard with existsLoud, so an unstattable bay cannot read as absent
tests: resolveRepoRoot throws when an ancestor .flume is present but unstattable
the --job state-root guard throws when the resolved flumeDir is present but unstattable
acceptance: Both probes refuse at the stat instead of proceeding: the walk no longer skips past an unstattable `.flume` to an unrelated ancestor, and the guard no longer reports `does not exist` over one.
notes: cli.ts already imports existsLoud (:57) and uses it at four sites; :287 is its last existsSync, so the import goes too (`engineering.md`, *The fix lands at the mechanism*: detection a sibling surface already performs). ELOOP via symlink is the fixture idiom here — tests/git.test.ts:714 — not a permission bit, which a root-run test bypasses.

summary: Probe both lockfiles with existsLoud in setupWorktree, so an unstattable lock cannot demote the install or raise the wrong refusal
tests: setupWorktree throws when pnpm-lock.yaml is present but unstattable
setupWorktree throws when package-lock.json is present but unstattable
acceptance: An unstattable lockfile refuses at the probe rather than falling through to `npm ci` or to the no-lockfile error, which the doc comment already promises never guesses.
notes: The hook's declared posture is "neither → rejects instead of guessing a package manager"; existsSync makes it guess anyway. ELOOP via symlink is the fixture idiom (tests/git.test.ts:714).
